headline: President Obama signed an order in 2016 updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order makes changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets out the rules and procedures for military justice, including how service members are tried for crimes. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: The rules used when service members are investigated, charged, or tried in military courts were updated.
They must follow the amended rules when handling military justice cases.
